_note: PLACEHOLDER measurements: realistic estimates, not measured (every block says measured:false). Units: mm, grams, degrees. Table frame: origin at the front-left corner of the bench footprint on the floor, x along the width (to the right), y along the depth (away from the front edge), z up from the floor. Angles are counter-clockwise seen from above, 0 = +x. Zones and bags give the centre (x, y) and size of a rectangle. Bags are open bins on the floor just outside the left and right bench edges: width x depth is the opening and height is the bin depth, so the rim is level with the bench top. The sweeper (can, servo, stick, tilt) is defined once, in config/models.json.

table._width: 250 mm (the minimum allowed) so the swept box can be carried past both side edges; see tests/fit.test.mjs.
table._height: height is the bench top above the floor. The bench is a 25 mm slab on a support; its top is 90 mm up so the 90 mm deep bags below its edges have rims level with the bench top.

pick._note: around the box stack, on the bench centreline, in front of the sweeper

scan._note: near the front edge, on the centreline
